records.label: Cloud & DevOps
records.name: Cloud & DevOps Solutions
records.introduction:
Cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices that accelerate your engineering teams.

We help organizations modernize their infrastructure with cloud-native architectures, automated deployment pipelines, and robust monitoring systems. From AWS and Azure to GCP, our DevOps engineers ensure your applications are reliable, scalable, and secure in production.

topics.Solutions:
Why choose ZuiGO for Cloud & DevOps?
ZuiGO's cloud & devops engagements are built around these outcomes:
- Cloud migration & modernization
- Automated CI/CD pipelines
- Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
- Containerization & orchestration
- 24/7 monitoring & incident response

What's included in a ZuiGO Cloud & DevOps engagement?
Every ZuiGO cloud & devops project ships with:
- Cloud migration & landing-zone setup
- CI/CD pipelines & release automation
- Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) modules
- Observability, alerting & incident runbooks
topics.How We Deliver:
How does ZuiGO deliver Cloud & DevOps?
ZuiGO delivers cloud & devops in 5 stages, from discovery through deployment:
Infrastructure Assessment
Evaluate current infrastructure, identify bottlenecks, and map migration paths.
Architecture Design
Design cloud-native architectures optimized for cost, performance, and resilience.
Implementation & Migration
Hands-on migration, infrastructure provisioning, and environment setup.
Automation & CI/CD
Build automated deployment pipelines and configuration management systems.
Monitoring & Management
Implement observability, alerting, and incident response protocols.
topics.Technologies:
Which technologies does ZuiGO use for Cloud & DevOps?
ZuiGO builds cloud & devops on the stack below. We choose technologies per project, so this is a representative set rather than a fixed requirement.
- AWS
- Azure
- GCP
- Terraform
- Docker
- Kubernetes
- GitHub Actions
- Grafana / Prometheus
topics.Projects:
What Cloud & DevOps projects does ZuiGO build?
These are representative cloud & devops projects ZuiGO builds — illustrative of typical scope and approach, not a client list.
Cloud migration
Moving workloads to a cloud-native landing zone with cost, security, and resilience baked in.
CI/CD automation
Pipelines that take code from PR to production in minutes with automated tests and safe rollbacks.
Observability rollout
Metrics, logs, and traces with actionable alerting and on-call runbooks for faster recovery.
